links.outcome: Physicians' use of unauthorized AI tools (Shadow AI) for clinical and administrative purposes
links.effect: Physicians reported using unauthorized AI for clinical decision support (differential diagnoses, rare cases), patient communication, documentation, research and curiosity; use compensated for perceived gaps in institutional systems.
links.quote: Physicians use Shadow AI for several purposes, which we grouped into 4 categories: clinical work and decision-making, administrative work, research and professional development, and technological interest and curiosity.

unlisted_practices: Governance approaches that account for physicians' unmet needs rather than relying on prohibition alone

screen.reason: Survey and qualitative content analysis examining real-world unauthorized/shadow AI use among Swedish physicians in clinical and administrative workflows.
